name: Solar Home System (Manohar Jyoti)
benefit: - **Subsidy for General Category:** A subsidy of ₹15,000/- per solar home system is provided to eligible families under the general category.  - **Subsidy under SCSP:** A subsidy covering 90% of the cost is provided to Scheduled Caste families under SCSP component.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should possess a valid Pariwar Pahichan Patra (PPP).
